items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against amended tax assessment
items.quote: Die Frist für die Einlegung des Einspruchs beträgt einen Monat. Sie beginnt mit Ablauf des Tages, an dem Ihnen dieser Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist. Bei Zusendung durch einfachen Brief gilt die Bekanntgabe mit dem dritten Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post als bewirkt, es sei denn, dass der Bescheid zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt zugegangen ist.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Tuesday 17.12.2024, which is before 1 Jan 2025, so the pre-2025 rule applies: delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed on the 3rd day after posting = 20.12.2024 (Friday), which is a normal working day so it is not shifted. Per § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the one-month Einspruch period begins with expiry of the delivery day (20.12.2024) and, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 20.01.2025 (a Monday, not a public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO is needed).

warnings: The tax amount is unchanged (6.918,00 € before and after) and there is no Nachzahlung (back payment) or Erstattung (refund), so no payment action is required despite this being a 'geänderter Bescheid'.

The Land in which this Finanzamt sits is not stated in the letterhead (only a placeholder town 'Neu-Musterdorf'); NRW public holidays were used by default for the Einspruch deadline as instructed, but if the office is actually in another Land this could shift the deadline if 20.01.2025 fell on a regional holiday there (it does not, so the date should be unaffected in practice).

Sender details look like generic template/placeholder data (town 'Neu-Musterdorf', bank 'Musterbank', example email address) rather than a real, unique Finanzamt — worth verifying this is a genuine letter from your actual local tax office.
